high_level_description: This image depicts a serene beachside setting with a wooden structure that appears to be a bar or a small café. The structure is open on one side, offering a direct view of the ocean. The roof is made of wood with exposed beams, and there are string lights hanging from it, adding a cozy ambiance. The bar area features a white countertop with a few wooden stools placed around it. There is a starfish decoration on the counter, enhancing the beach theme.
